title: Guy Banister reports UFO sightings to Hoover under special mission X

tellings.quote: >> guy Banister's job is reporting on UFO sightings back to Hoover

plain: In 1947, in the Pacific Northwest, a man named Guy Banister had the job of reporting UFO sightings back to J. Edgar Hoover, the head of the FBI, under an assignment called "special mission X". A researcher named Peter Levenda, presented on the show as a historian of the CIA, tells this without naming a source. If true, it would mean the FBI was quietly collecting UFO reports from the very start of the modern sightings.
